{{Infobox place|name=The Thornland|type=Region|region=South of the Ash Fields of [[the Banner-lands]]|house=[[House Blackthorn]]}}
Hilly, difficult inland terrain south of [[the Ash Fields]]. One wins here with cunning and planning, not strength — the country that shaped [[House Blackthorn]]. Poor land, no ore, no trade; its power is being indispensable in war.
